units.literal: When grown he changed his ways, studied the Masters and histories, was also rather skilled at composition, and was ardent in spirit and aspiration.

units.zh: 對曰：「數尋伊、霍之傳，不讀曹、馬之書。」
units.en: He replied, "I pore over the lives of Yi Yin and Huo Guang — not the chronicles of Cao Cao and the Sima clan."
units.literal: He replied: "I often seek the biographies of Yi Yin and Huo Guang; I do not read the books of Cao [Cao] and the Sima [clan]."

units.zh: 天保二年，從駕至晉陽，於宮門外罵元韶曰：「爾不及一老嫗，背負璽與人，何不打碎之。
units.en: In Tianbao year two, while following the imperial carriage to Jinyang, he reviled Yuan Shao outside the palace gate: "You are worse than an old crone — you bore the seal on your back and handed it to another. Why not have smashed it?
units.literal: In the second year of Tianbao, following the imperial carriage to Jinyang, outside the palace gate he reviled Yuan Shao: "You are not equal to an old woman — you carried the seal on your back and gave it to another; why did you not smash it?

units.zh: 今逢世路阻，狐兔鬱縱橫。」
units.en: Today the road is blocked; foxes and hares throng the crossways."
units.literal: Today we meet blocked roads in the world; foxes and hares throng the crossways."

units.zh: 我出此言，卽知死也，然爾亦詎得幾時！」
units.en: I speak this knowing I shall die — but how much longer will you last?"
units.literal: I speak these words knowing I shall die — yet how much longer will you have!"

units.zh: 文宣聞而殺之，亦斬臨淮公孝友。
units.en: Gao Yang heard and had him killed; he also beheaded Duke of Linhuai Xiaoyou.
units.literal: When Gao Yang heard of it he had him killed and also beheaded Duke of Linhuai Xiaoyou.

units.zh: 仍鑿冰沉其屍。
units.en: Their bodies were sunk through holes cut in the ice.
units.literal: They then cut ice and sank their corpses.

units.zh: 孝友臨刑，驚惶失措，暉業神色自若。
units.en: At the block Xiaoyou panicked; Huiye's bearing never changed.
units.literal: Facing execution, Xiaoyou was panic-stricken and at a loss; Huiye's bearing was calm.

units.zh: 二年冬，被詔入晉陽宮，出與元暉業同被害。
units.en: In the winter of the second year he was summoned by edict to Jinyang Palace; on leaving he was killed together with Yuan Huiye.
units.literal: In the winter of the second year he was summoned by edict into Jinyang Palace and, on leaving, was killed together with Yuan Huiye.

units.zh: 暉業以時運漸謝，不復圖全，唯事飲啖，一日一羊，三日一犢。
units.en: As the times waned, Huiye ceased to plot for his own survival; he gave himself only to eating and drinking — a sheep each day, a calf every three days.
units.literal: Huiye, seeing the times gradually decline, no longer plotted for survival; he devoted himself only to eating and drinking — one sheep a day, one calf every three days.

units.zh: 弼覺，即告暉業，終如其言。
units.en: When Bi awoke he told Huiye at once, and in the end it proved true.
units.literal: When Bi awoke he at once told Huiye, and in the end it was as spoken.

units.zh: 或曰：「其行臺郎王偉。」
units.en: Someone said, "It was his mobile-court gentleman Wang Wei."
units.literal: Someone said: "It was his Mobile Court Gentleman Wang Wei."

units.zh: 王尋覽書，問誰為作。
units.en: When Gao Cheng had read the letter, he asked who had written it.
units.literal: When the Prince had read the letter, he asked who had written it.

units.zh: 榮敗，隨尒朱榮，為別將討元顥，以功封敷城縣男。
units.en: When Rong was defeated he followed Erzhu Rong, served as a separate commander against Yuan Hao, and for merit was enfeoffed baron of Fucheng County.
units.literal: When Rong was defeated he followed Erzhu Rong, served as a separate commander against Yuan Hao, and for merit was enfeoffed Baron of Fucheng County.

units.zh: 溉，〔一〕時梁州刺史陰子春、領軍朱异在焉。
units.en: Collation variant: (Gai), [1] At that time Liang inspector of Liangzhou Yin Zichun and director of the palace guard Zhu Yi were present.
units.literal: Collation variant: (Gai), At that time Liang Inspector of Liangzhou Yin Zichun and Director of the Palace Guard Zhu Yi were present.

units.zh: 子春素知申，即於坐所呼與為對，〔二〕申每有妙思，异觀而奇之，因引申遊處。
units.en: Zichun had long known Shen and immediately at the gathering called him to play a match, [2] Shen had fine conceptions each time; Yi watched and marveled, and thereafter drew Shen into his company.
units.literal: Zichun had long known Shen and immediately at the gathering called him to play a match, Shen had fine conceptions each time; Yi watched and marveled, and thereafter drew Shen into his company.

units.zh: 孝昌三年，除左將軍、太中大夫、兼左丞，為齊兗二州行臺，節度大都督李叔仁。
units.en: In the third year of Xiaochang he was appointed Left General, Grand Master of Palace Counsel, and concurrent Left Assistant Director, and served as mobile headquarters over the two provinces of Qi and Yan directing Grand Commander-in-Chief Li Shuren.
units.literal: In the third year of Xiaochang, he was appointed Left General, Grand Master of Palace Counsel, and concurrent Left Assistant Director; he served as mobile headquarters over Qi and the two Yanzhou provinces, directing Grand Commander-in-Chief Li Shuren.

units.zh: 按卷九肅宗紀孝昌三年二月庚申稱東郡民趙顯德反，詔都督李叔仁討之；
units.en: According to juan 9 of Emperor Suzong's annals, on gengshen day in the second month of the third year of Xiaochang, the people of Dong Commandery under Zhao Xiande rebelled, and an edict ordered Commander-in-Chief Li Shuren to suppress them;
units.literal: According to juan 9 of the Annals of Emperor Suzong, in the third year of Xiaochang, second month, day gengshen, it says the people of Dong Commandery under Zhao Xiande rebelled and an edict ordered Commander-in-Chief Li Shuren to attack them;

units.zh: 三月辛未又稱齊州廣川民劉鈞執清河太守邵懷聚眾反，六月稱詔都督李叔仁討劉鈞平之。
units.en: on xinwei day in the third month it records that Liu Jun of Guangchuan in Qizhou seized Grand Administrator Shao Huai of Qinghe and raised a rebellion; in the sixth month an edict ordered Commander-in-Chief Li Shuren to attack Liu Jun and pacify him.
units.literal: third month, day xinwei, it again says the people of Guangchuan in Qizhou, Liu Jun, seized the Grand Administrator of Qinghe, Shao Huai, gathered a host and rebelled; sixth month says an edict ordered Commander-in-Chief Li Shuren to attack Liu Jun and pacify him.

units.zh: 節度大都督李叔仁
units.en: Grand Commander-in-Chief and Controller Li Shuren
units.literal: Grand Commander-in-Chief and Controller Li Shuren

units.zh: 盧同以齊兗二州行臺節度李叔仁，所闕必即鎮壓這兩支變亂軍事，但紀不書盧同以行臺節度事。
units.en: Lu Tong, as mobile headquarters over Qi and the two Yanzhou provinces, directed Li Shuren; the missing passage must concern the suppression of these two rebellions, though the annals do not record Tong's role as mobile headquarters commander.
units.literal: Lu Tong, as mobile headquarters of Qi and Yanzhou, controlled Li Shuren; what is missing must be the suppression of these two rebellions, yet the annals do not record Lu Tong's role as mobile headquarters controller.

units.zh: 侯景遣將宋子仙據郢州，琳攻剋之，擒子仙。
units.en: Hou Jing sent General Song Zixian to hold Yingzhou; Lin attacked and took it, capturing Zixian.
units.literal: Hou Jing sent General Song Zixian to hold Yingzhou; Lin attacked and took it, capturing Zixian.

units.zh: 兆不納，殺帝，而與尒朱世隆等立長廣王曄，改元建明。
units.en: Zhao refused to heed him, killed the emperor, and with Erzhu Shilong and others enthroned Ye, Prince of Changguang, changing the era name to Jianming.
units.literal: Zhao did not accept; he killed the emperor, and with Erzhu Shilong and others enthroned Prince Changguang Ye and changed the era name to Jianming.

units.zh: 時世隆、度律、彥伯共執朝政，天光據關右，兆據幷州，仲遠據東郡，各擁兵為暴，天下苦之。
units.en: Erzhu Shilong, Dulü, and Yanbo held the court; Tianguang held the west, Zhao held Bing Province, and Zhongyuan held Dong Commandery—each tyrannized with armed force, and all under heaven groaned.
units.literal: At that time Shilong, Dulü, and Yanbo jointly wielded court governance; Tianguang held the pass west, Zhao held Bing Province, Zhongyuan held Dong Commandery — each amassed troops and acted as tyrants, and the realm suffered bitterly.

units.zh: 孝莊卽位，除左中兵郎中，為尚書令臨淮王彧譴責，遊道乃執版長揖曰：「下官謝王瞋，不謝王理。」
units.en: When Emperor Xiaozhuang took the throne, Youdao became Left Central Army Bureau gentleman; censured by Director Yuan Ye, Prince of Linhuai, Youdao held his board and bowed: "I thank your anger, my lord, not your reasoning."
units.literal: When Emperor Xiaozhuang took the throne, Youdao was made Left Central Army Bureau gentleman; censured by Director of the Masters of Writing Prince of Huaiyang Yuan Ye, Youdao held his board and made a long bow, saying: "Your servant thanks the prince's anger, not the prince's reason."

units.zh: 為臣此言，彧賜怒更甚。
units.en: For these words Ye's anger grew worse.
units.literal: For these words of your servant, Ye's gift of anger grew still worse.

units.zh: 尚書令臨淮王彧卽孚之兄子，遣省事謝遠三日之中八度逼迫，云宜依判許。
units.en: Director Yuan Ye, Prince of Linhuai, is Fu's nephew; within three days his clerk Xie Yuan pressed eight times for approval by precedent.
units.literal: Director of the Masters of Writing Prince of Huaiyang Yuan Ye is Fu's brother's son; within three days his clerk Xie Yuan pressed eight times that it should be allowed by precedent.

units.zh: 彧亦奏言：「臣忝冠百僚，遂使一郎攘袂高聲，肆言頓挫，乞解尚書令。」
units.en: Ye also memorialized: "I crown the hundred officials, yet one gentleman rolls up his sleeves and speaks loudly to blunt me; I beg relief from Director of the Masters of Writing."
units.literal: Ye also memorialized: "Your servant crowns the hundred officials, yet a single gentleman rolls up his sleeves and speaks loudly, freely speaking to blunt and humiliate; I beg to be relieved of Director of the Masters of Writing."

units.zh: 沈眾 袁泌 劉仲威 陸山才 王質 韋載 族弟翽
units.en: Shen Zhong; Yuan Bi; Liu Zhongwei; Lu Shancai; Wang Zhi; Wei Zai; younger clansman Hui
units.literal: Shen Zhong; Yuan Bi; Liu Zhongwei; Lu Shancai; Wang Zhi; Wei Zai; younger clansman Hui

units.zh: 王質字子貞，右光祿大夫通之弟也。
units.en: Wang Zhi, styled Zizhen, was the younger brother of right grand master of the golden sigil Tong.
units.literal: Wang Zhi, styled Zizhen, was the younger brother of Right Grand Master of the Golden Sigil Tong.

units.zh: 贈本官，諡曰安子。
units.en: He was posthumously given his former rank, with the posthumous name Anzi.
units.literal: He was posthumously given his former office; posthumous name Anzi.

units.zh: 梁世以武帝甥封甲口亭侯，補國子周易生，射策高第。
units.en: Under Liang, as the emperor's sister's son, he was enfeoffed as Marquis of Jiakou and studied the Book of Changes at the national university, ranking high in the archery examination.
units.literal: In Liang times, as Emperor Wu's sister's son he was enfeoffed Marquis of Jiakou ting, entered the National University as student of the Book of Changes, and ranked high in the archery examination.

units.zh: 太清元年，除假節、寧遠將軍，領東宮兵，從貞陽侯北伐。
units.en: In the first year of Taiqing (547) he was given the staff as General Who Pacifies the Distance, led the eastern palace troops on the Marquis of Zhenyang's northern campaign.
units.literal: In the first year of Taiqing he was made Bearer of the Staff and General Who Pacifies the Distance and led the Eastern Palace troops in the Marquis of Zhenyang's northern campaign.

units.zh: 永定二年，高祖命質率所部踰嶺出豫章，隨都督周文育以討王琳。
units.en: In the second year of Yongding (558) the Founder ordered Zhi to lead his command over the mountains into Yuzhang and follow Commander Zhou Wenyu against Wang Lin.
units.literal: In the second year of Yongding the Founder ordered Zhi to lead his command over the ridge into Yuzhang and follow Commander Zhou Wenyu against Wang Lin.

units.zh: 文帝嗣位，徵守五兵尚書。
units.en: When Emperor Wen succeeded he was recalled to head the ministry of war.
units.literal: When Emperor Wen succeeded he was summoned to hold the Ministry of War.

units.zh: 遭母憂，居喪以孝聞。
units.en: When his mother died he mourned her and was known for filial piety.
units.literal: On his mother's death he observed mourning and was known for filial piety.

units.zh: 景軍濟江，質便退走。
units.en: When Jing's army crossed the Yangzi, Zhi at once fell back.
units.literal: When Jing's army crossed the river, Zhi at once withdrew.

units.zh: 景軍至京師，質不戰而潰，乃翦髮為桑門，潛匿人間。
units.en: When Jing's army reached the capital, Zhi did not fight; his troops broke and he shaved his head as a monk and hid among the people.
units.literal: When Jing's army reached the capital, Zhi did not fight and his troops collapsed; he then shaved his head as a monk and hid among the people.

units.zh: 京城陷後，西奔荊州，元帝承制，以質為右長史，帶河東太守。
units.en: After the capital fell he fled west to Jingzhou. Emperor Yuan of Liang, under the provisional regime, made him right chief clerk and administrator of Hedong.
units.literal: After the capital fell he fled west to Jingzhou; Emperor Yuan of Liang under the provisional regime made him Right Chief Clerk, concurrently Administrator of Hedong.

units.zh: 尋出為持節、都督吳州諸軍事、寧遠將軍、吳州刺史，領鄱陽內史。
units.en: He was soon sent out with the staff as commander of military affairs over Wu, General Who Pacifies the Distance, inspector of Wu, and interior magistrate of Poyang.
units.literal: Soon he went out as Bearer of the Staff, Commander of Military Affairs over Wu province, General Who Pacifies the Distance, and Inspector of Wu, concurrently Interior Magistrate of Poyang.

units.zh: 質與琳素善，或譖云於軍中潛信交通，高祖命周文育殺質，文育啟請救之，獲免。
units.en: Zhi and Lin had long been friends. Some accused him of secret correspondence with Lin in the field. The Founder ordered Zhou Wenyu to execute him; Wenyu pleaded for his life and he was spared.
units.literal: Zhi and Lin had long been on good terms; some slandered him, saying that in the army he secretly corresponded with Lin; the Founder ordered Zhou Wenyu to kill Zhi; Wenyu memorialized to plead for his life, and he was spared.

units.zh: 太建二年卒，時年六十。
units.en: In the second year of Taijian (570) he died, aged sixty.
units.literal: In the second year of Taijian he died, aged sixty.

units.zh: 天嘉二年，除晉安太守。
units.en: In Tianjia year 2 (561), he was made administrator of Jin'an.
units.literal: In Tianjia year 2, he was made administrator of Jin'an.

units.zh: 及貞陽敗績，質脫身逃還。
units.en: When Zhenyang was beaten, Zhi slipped away and returned.
units.literal: When Zhenyang was defeated, Zhi escaped and returned.

units.zh: 侯景於壽陽構逆，質又領舟師隨眾軍拒之。
units.en: When Hou Jing rebelled at Shouyang, Zhi again led the river fleet with the allied armies to block him.
units.literal: When Hou Jing rebelled at Shouyang, Zhi again led the river forces with the massed armies to resist him.

units.zh: 及柳仲禮等會援京邑，軍據南岸，質又收合餘眾從之。
units.en: When Liu Zhongli and others united to relieve the capital, their army held the south bank. Zhi again gathered the remnant troops and joined them.
units.literal: When Liu Zhongli and the others united to relieve the capital, the army held the south bank; Zhi again gathered the remaining troops and joined them.

units.zh: 荊州陷，侯瑱鎮于湓城，與質不協，遣偏將羊亮代質，且以兵臨之，質率所部，度信安嶺，依于留異。
units.en: When Jing province fell, Hou Tian held Tangcheng and clashed with Zhi. He sent the subordinate general Yang Liang to replace him and advanced with troops. Zhi led his command over the Xin'an Ridge and joined Liu Yi.
units.literal: When Jing province fell, Hou Tian held Tangcheng and was at odds with Zhi; he sent a subordinate general, Yang Liang, to replace Zhi and also pressed him with troops; Zhi led his command over the Xin'an Ridge and attached himself to Liu Yi.

units.zh: 文帝鎮會稽，以兵助質，令鎮信安縣。
units.en: When Emperor Wen held Kuaiji he sent troops to aid Zhi and had him guard Xin'an county.
units.literal: When Emperor Wen garrisoned Kuaiji he sent troops to aid Zhi and had him hold Xin'an county.

units.zh: 高宗為揚州刺史，以質為仁威將軍、驃騎府長史。
units.en: When Emperor Xuan was inspector of Yangzhou he made Zhi general of benevolent prestige and chief clerk to the flying cavalry.
units.literal: When Emperor Xuan was Inspector of Yangzhou he made Zhi General of Benevolent Prestige and Chief Clerk to the Flying Cavalry.

units.zh: 高宗輔政，以為司徒左長史，將軍如故。
units.en: When Emperor Xuan was regent he made Zhi left chief clerk to the minister of education, retaining his general's title.
units.literal: When Emperor Xuan served as regent he made Zhi Left Chief Clerk of the Secretariat, general unchanged.

units.zh: 魏徐州刺史元延明聞革才名，厚加接待。
units.en: Yuan Yanming, Wei governor of Xuzhou, had heard of Ge's fame and received him with deep respect.
units.literal: Wei Governor of Xuzhou Yuan Yanming, hearing of Ge's literary reputation, treated him with great honor.

units.zh: 革稱患腳不拜，延明將加害焉，見革辭色嚴正，更相敬重。
units.en: Ge claimed a bad leg and refused to bow. Yanming meant to punish him, but Ge's stern bearing in word and face won respect instead.
units.literal: Ge pleaded a lame leg and would not bow; Yanming was about to harm him, but seeing Ge's stern dignity in speech and bearing, treated him with renewed respect.

units.zh: 時祖𣈶同被拘執，延明使𣈶作《欹器》、《漏刻銘》，革罵𣈶曰：「卿荷國厚恩，已無報答，今乃爲虜立銘，孤負朝廷。」
units.en: Zu Can was held with him. Yanming had Can write inscriptions for the Tilting Vessel and the Clepsydra. Ge reviled him: "The state heaped grace on you and you never repaid it. Now you write for the captors and betray the court."
units.literal: At the time Zu Can was also detained; Yanming had Can compose inscriptions for the Tilting Vessel and the Clepsydra. Ge cursed Can: "You received the state's deep grace yet have no repayment; now you write inscriptions for the enemy—betraying the court."

units.zh: 延明聞之，乃令革作丈八寺碑並祭彭祖文，革辭以囚執旣久，無復心思。
units.en: Yanming then ordered Ge to compose the Zhangba Temple stele and a sacrifice to Peng Zu. Ge refused: long imprisonment had drained his mind.
units.literal: Yanming heard and ordered Ge to write the Zhangba Temple stele and a text sacrificing to Peng Zu; Ge refused, saying long captivity had left him no heart for such work.

units.zh: 延明逼之逾苦，將加箠撲。
units.en: Yanming pressed harder and was about to have him flogged.
units.literal: Yanming pressed him harder and would have had him beaten.

units.zh: 延明知不可屈，乃止。
units.en: Yanming saw he could not be bent and desisted.
units.literal: Yanming knew he could not be broken and stopped.

units.zh: 又手敕云：「世間果報，不可不信，豈得底突如對元延明邪？」
units.en: A handwritten edict added: "Worldly retribution is real. How can you be a stubborn bump with Yuan Yanming as you were before?"
units.literal: Also a handwritten edict: "Worldly retribution cannot be disbelieved—how can one be a stubborn bump as before Yuan Yanming?"

units.zh: 有妖賊僧強，自稱天子，土豪蔡伯龍起兵應之，眾起三萬，攻陷北徐州；
units.en: A sorcerer-monk named Qiang styled himself Son of Heaven; the local magnate Cai Bolong rose in support, and their host reached thirty thousand, storming Northern Xuzhou;
units.literal: There was a demonic bandit monk, Qiang, who styled himself Son of Heaven; the local strongman Cai Bolong raised troops in response, and their host rose to thirty thousand, attacking and taking Northern Xuzhou;

units.zh: 昕少與邢卲俱為元羅賓友，及守東萊，卲舉室就之。
units.en: In youth Xin and Xing Shao had both been guests of Yuan Luo; when Xin held Donglai, Shao brought his whole household to join him.
units.literal: In youth Xin and Xing Shao had both been guests of Yuan Luo; when Xin held Donglai, Shao brought his whole household to join him.
